Ravi Beaumont
ravi.beaumont@example.com | Cleveland, OH
Ravi Beaumont has 7 years of experience in design. Most recently, Senior
Product Designer at Thistledown Holdings (2024-2026), where they built and
maintained the company's design system components and guidelines. Before that,
Product Designer at Pixel & Pine Media (2019-2024). Education: M.S. Digital
Media, University of Oregon, 2019; B.S. Digital Media, University of Oregon,
2017. Core skills: UX research, Wireframing, Figma, Visual design, Prototyping.
